backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only PIT Form 4 transaction rows on usable_trade_date plus close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date. Paper entry is next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The pressure resilience candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

gate3_survival_note: Core survival is checked by BASE_GATE4. Target survival is a default-off overlay candidate sample; no additional filter is added after Gate 3.

gate_questions.3_single_causal_variable: One fixed policy bundle: PIT-safe Form 4 non-derivative sale rows with transaction_code=S, acquired_disposed_code=D, usable_trade_date, and same-day ticker total sale value >= $1M; same ticker core overlap is excluded; the existing liquid leadership envelope, top-1 next-open paper entry, 10-day hold, costs, cooldown, comparator, and concentration gates are inherited unchanged.
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Treat as positive replay lead only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, no EV/PnL regression window appears, target sample >=20 across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration guard passes, and both accepted compression and distribution comparators are beaten. A shared default-off helper and daily parity path are required for any retention.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: large PIT-safe Form 4 insider sales are usually an overhang, but if the issuer still closes with liquid SPY-relative leadership on the usable trade date, the tape may be revealing institutional demand strong enough to absorb insider supply and continue after next-open paper entry.
interpretation: The Form 4 sale absorption leadership source was rejected; it did not establish a distinct free SEC Form 4/OHLCV candidate-pool edge under the standard three-window protocol.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that disclosed insider sales, including routine 10b5-1 selling, remain an overhang even when the stock shows short-term liquid leadership. The Form 4 sale source may also be too concentrated in mega-cap tech and recent IPO/AI names, so apparent absorption is not a distinct edge after next-open execution and costs. Do not answer by sweeping sale-value thresholds, top-N, hold days, cooldown, notional, or role weights on these frozen windows.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs materially new PIT evidence, such as forward daily replacement value on sale clusters, explicit post-sale ownership-retention context, or a shared default-off daily Form 4 sale-absorption adapter with non-replay observations. Pure threshold, role, 10b5-1, or liquidity retunes stay frozen.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping sale-value thresholds, owner roles, 10b5-1 flags, top-N, notional, hold days, or cooldown on these windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs materially new PIT evidence, such as forward daily replacement value on sale clusters, explicit post-sale ownership-retention context, or a shared default-off daily Form 4 sale-absorption adapter with non-replay observations. Pure threshold, role, 10b5-1, or liquidity retunes stay frozen.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The Form 4 sale absorption source did not clear Gate 4. Large insider sale disclosures were either routine, already absorbed before entry, or concentrated in names where the sale overhang did not provide an incremental candidate-pool edge beyond the existing liquid leadership envelope.

prediction.confidence_reason: Prior Form 4 purchase and owner-count/liquidity variants were not durable enough. This run tests the opposite evidence class: whether large disclosed insider sale supply that fails to break same-day liquid leadership identifies institutional absorption. The idea is production-visible through free SEC Form 4 rows but remains a private replay scout because the sale-side data shape is uncertain.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result would remain only a replay lead. Promotion would require one shared default-off adapter that loads the same PIT Form 4 transaction rows, uses the same non-derivative sale definition, minimum sale value, signal-date OHLCV leadership envelope, same-ticker core overlap exclusion, top-1 next-open paper entry, 10-trading-day exit, costs, cooldown, comparator, and concentration guards in both historical replay and daily production before any report queue, paper ledger, candidate priority, sizing, watchlist, or order surface could change.
